local_news.headline: Coastal flood advisory for the San Diego coast through Wednesday
local_news.summary: The National Weather Service has a coastal flood advisory for San Diego County coastal areas, in effect Monday 5 AM through Wednesday 5 PM. Minor coastal flooding and erosion are expected at morning high tides, with elevated surf of 3 to 5 feet and strong rip currents. The advisory says to stay off rock walls and jetties and to avoid beaches during morning high tides.

local_news.headline: County posts current beach advisories and closures
local_news.summary: Our own note: San Diego County's Beach and Bay program posts current water-contact advisories and closures for county beaches. Check the linked page for today's list. This is context, not an agency notice.
